set.body:
Current release queue, 7 October 2026: release-1.0; milestone-release.
Plan: docs/refactor/RELEASE-QUEUE.md. Mote remains authoritative; one primary agent and at most one helper.

Reconciliation: Its sole child closed as superseded back into this parent/facade. Current MappingExchangeBuild has bare I/O refusals; StoryBuild Complete can contain an unvalidated draft; PublicAlignAndInterpret still assembles internals manually. No MappingPipeline exists. Do not resurrect the superseded universal refusal-supertype migration.

Remaining / next action: After the ordinary-file facade, qualify safe actionable errors, execution/validity/requested-capability distinctions, CLI exit behavior and newcomer analyze/inspect/export workflow under failure injection.

Release tags schedule work; they do not establish completion or empirical qualification. Use current AGENTS.md for ownership, scoped gates and exact-SHA review; old fleet roles, timers and fixed gate task counts are historical. Keep the original scientific preregistration, denominators, admission and sealed-test rules below.

Retained acceptance and design context:

Scheduling lane: release. Current plan: docs/refactor/PLAN.md. Live dependency edges supersede historical sequencing below.

Governing plan: docs/refactor/PLAN.md (2026-09-19); ADR 0019. Key: hardening; lane: release.

Scope: pipeline public error facade, docs-site examples

Acceptance criteria:
1. Public entry points return typed actionable failures with path and exception class where safe; keep source/participant prose out of logs.
2. Requested capability failure and invalid draft are distinct from success; tests cover advertised CLI exit behavior.
3. Unify only errors crossing this facade where a concrete consumer needs it. A repository-wide migration of all 45 refusal types is deferred.
4. A newcomer executes documented local analyze/inspect/export calls without manually assembling internal proof objects; facade cannot bypass identity/privacy/validation.

Validation: public MappingPipelineSuite consumer tests and docs-site example verification

Completion evidence: exact baseline/result SHA, executable command and bound test totals/exit, artifact digests, discriminating failure injection, compatibility impact, separate SD6 review. Run reference-scope for the actual diff and SD2 checkAll before landing. Proposed suite names below are acceptance specifications, not existing or executed tests. No efficacy claim follows from a synthetic pass.

Boundary: Supersedes the broad progressive-facade request for this delivery; unrelated API ergonomics remain later.
